content: We finetune GreenBioBERT on the eight publicly available NER tasks used in BIBREF2. We also do reproduction experiments with general-domain BERT and BioBERTv1.0, using the same setup as our model. We average results over eight random seeds. See Appendix for details on preprocessing, training and hyperparameters.
